patterns.what_worked: Reading the dead attempt's partials against the frozen specs first: hold_seconds (hunter_window) and rules 2b + the lust suppression (hunter_guide) were already correct and were kept verbatim; only the consumers (cast-bar label, gather wiring, tests) were missing. The frozen C2 contract was consumed exactly as documented (nil = no window, throttle in the calling lane), and the paladin lane's P3 throttle shape was mirrored, so H2 reads identically on both desks.
patterns.what_was_hard: H1's display target: the bank's 'HOLD seconds' has no reference counterpart (SuperSwingTimer shows the numeric Auto Shot countdown only), so the kernel was wired into the cast bar's window face - the same bounds the HOLD overlay keys on - and documented as a SwedgeTimer display kernel. The H6 Frenzy id needed external sourcing (19615, wowhead TBC/WotLK) because the bench carried no pet ids; the Forever variant (428728) is 403-blocked and stays out.
patterns.skill_gap: The offline harness cannot load the addon: badge geometry/anchoring on a live bar, the cast-zone colours in motion, and the client reads (19574/19615/23989/5384, Bloodlust aura payload) stay UNCONFIRMED until an in-client session.
